findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "price_alert" is 688 chars, far longer than this server's median (136). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_watchlist, price_alert, get_news · Public sink: build_trade_plan · Destructive: scan_watchlist, price_alert, find_sector_stock_pipeline_tool, backtest_macd_momentum, backtest_macd_trend_follower, backtest_mean_reversion_rsi_bb, backtest_rsi_mean_reversion, backtest_sma_crossover, backtest_trend_crossover, backtest_volatility_breakout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_watchlist, price_alert, get_news · Public sink: build_trade_plan · Destructive: scan_watchlist, price_alert, find_sector_stock_pipeline_tool, backtest_macd_momentum, backtest_macd_trend_follower, backtest_mean_reversion_rsi_bb, backtest_rsi_mean_reversion, backtest_sma_crossover, backtest_trend_crossover, backtest_volatility_breakout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
